mission_05: Great work! You have successfully implemented CutMix augmentation. You learned how to calculate a random bounding box, cut a patch from one image and paste it onto another, and adjust labels proportionally based on the area ratio. CutMix combines the benefits of mixup (label smoothing) with more realistic sample generation since it preserves original pixel values. This technique has been shown to improve classification accuracy, object detection, and segmentation tasks. The key insight is that by training on partial objects, the model learns to recognize features from incomplete visual information.
